comment: After OOBE: script Post-OOBE.ps1, a scheduled task running as SYSTEM at startup.
The infrastructure (task, wait for IMAGE_STATE_COMPLETE, profile read into $cfg and $accounts, task removal)
is added by the generator when at least one rule of the phase is on. The runtime provides Write-Log, $cfg, $accounts.

rules.title: "Password never expires" flag on the initial accounts
rules.summary: PasswordNeverExpires is set for every account the answer file creates. Duplicates the machine-wide net accounts setting in case it is changed.
rules.effect: The initial accounts without a password will not be required to change the password. An account typed during installation ("Ask for the account during installation") is covered by the machine-wide setting only.
rules.verify: Get-LocalUser -Name Admin, User | Select-Object Name, PasswordExpires: the PasswordExpires field is empty.
rules.rollback: Set-LocalUser -Name <name> -PasswordNeverExpires $false as administrator; do this together with assigning passwords.

rules.title: Built-in Administrator and Guest stay disabled
rules.summary: The accounts with RID 500 and 501 are found by SID (the names are localized on the Ukrainian image) and disabled if they are enabled.
rules.effect: The well-known names cannot be used to sign in.
rules.verify: Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID.Value -match '-50[01]$' } | Select-Object Name, Enabled: both accounts have Enabled = False.
rules.rollback: Enable-LocalUser -SID <SID> as administrator. Enabling the built-in Administrator is not recommended: its name is known to everyone.

script: if ($u.Enabled) { Disable-LocalUser -SID $u.SID; Write-Log "built-in account $($u.Name) disabled" } else { Write-Log "built-in account $($u.Name) already disabled" }

rules.title: Move specialize pass errors to the log
rules.summary: If the specialize command wrappers recorded an error (the script was not extracted or failed), its text goes to Post-OOBE.log marked SPECIALIZE ERROR.
rules.effect: The only way to find out that the machine script did not run.
rules.verify: C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs\Post-OOBE.log: no SPECIALIZE ERROR lines; no C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err file.
rules.rollback: Not required: the rule only moves the error text to the log and deletes the temporary file.

script: try { Get-Content 'C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err' | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "SPECIALIZE ERROR: $_" }; Remove-Item 'C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err' -Force } catch { }

rules.title: Delete answer file copies from the system
rules.summary: Windows 11 24H2 leaves copies of the answer file (with account names and passwords, if there were any) in C:\Windows\Panther; they are deleted.
rules.effect: No description of the accounts remains on the disk.
rules.versions: Windows 10 kept one copy, 24H2 keeps two.
rules.verify: Test-Path C:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml and Test-Path C:\Windows\Panther\unattend-original.xml return False.
rules.rollback: Cannot be rolled back and is not needed: the running system does not need the copies, and the original file remains on the installation media.

script: try { Remove-Item -Path $f -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log "deleted $f" } catch { Write-Log "could not delete $f : $($_.Exception.Message)" }
